Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities on human single-protein target CHEMBL1075115. Join activities to assays, target dictionary, molecule dictionary, and compound structures. Filter for standard type IC50, exact standard relation equals, non-null pChEMBL value, and target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1075115. Return the first 1000 rows ordered by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
